title: Perspectivalness: a world centered on a phenomenal self

statements.text: Perspectivalness is a structural feature of phenomenal space: a single, coherent, temporally stable model of reality centered on a single phenomenal subject, so that experience has a focus and a point of view. Consciousness with this feature is the appearance of a world from a first-person perspective.

sources.quote: Consciousness is the appearance of a world from a first-person perspective.
phenomenal space is centred by a phenomenal self
